newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Iran to build $800 million refinery in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Iran to build $800 million refinery in Bangladesh.

text.p: Iran will build a oil refinery in Bangladesh at a cost of $800 million, Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Alauddin Brujerdi said here on Thursday.
"Even though the project is costly we are eager to implement it as the bilateral relations between the two countries are improving," he told a news conference.
He gave no other details but said: "We achieved preliminary understanding regarding this project."
Brujerdi said a delegation from Bangladesh would soon visit Iran to draw up detailed outlines for the the project.

Iran is one of the potential sources of Bangladesh's oil imports. Bangladesh has already a refinery in southern Chittagong having a capicity of refining more than 1.0 million tonnes of crude annually.
